Group rides in Ohio

21 recurring group rides around Ohio: 14 road, 9 social, 3 mixed. 12 roll on weeknights, 7 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with UBBC Tuesday Night Ride in Cincinnati — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? TAB Windsday Ride runs road B (19–21 mph); gravel C/D (16–20 mph).
